title: Procurement-aligned Model Landscape Brief for Enterprise RFPs
creator: Aisha Rao
description:
Background: Sales & Solutions teams are seeing a growth in late-stage enterprise RFPs that include detailed technical requirements (SLA, on-prem options, KMS integration, quantized model support, token-level cost estimates). Existing model-landscape artifacts are oriented toward product fit and latency economics, but not specifically structured for procurement/compliance evaluation.

Objective: Deliver a procurement-aligned Model Landscape Brief and an accompanying playbook that accelerates responses to enterprise RFPs. This ticket will synthesize competitive positioning, a decision rubric mapping model variants to RFP criteria, and a short list of procurement-ready artifact templates (model capability matrix, cost-runway estimate, latency/SLA evidence pack).

Deliverables (final):
- Procurement Model Brief (PDF/Confluence): one-page executive summary + 3-page appendix with technical comparators.
- RFP Rubric (spreadsheet): weighted scoring for common enterprise requirements (SLA, private deployment, KMS/HSM, quantization, supported sequence lengths, per-token cost).
- Procurement Evidence Pack template: observability snapshots, rollout history, sustained-latency SLO charts, security/compliance checklist.
- Signalization plan: telemetry events & dashboard spec to flag accounts approaching procurement thresholds (monthly spend, SLA hits, private deployment requests).

Scope & Constraints:
- Focus on open / curated model variants commonly surfaced in RFPs (small/medium dense, quantized 4/8-bit variants, and proven hosted variants). Do not undertake a full vendor procurement RFP response; this is an internal enablement artifact for Sales and Solutions.
- Timebox: research & synthesis -> 2 team sprints.

Methodology:
1) Rapid competitor scan (public specs, pricing, published SLAs).
2) Internal telemetry pull (top 25 accounts by spend / last 12 months) to identify procurement triggers.
3) Technical validation: run microbenchmarks for latency/cost on representative prompt sets (RAG, chat, embeddings).
4) Cross-functional review with Solutions, Security, and Runtime eng.

Acceptance criteria:
- Confluence brief reviewed and approved by Solutions lead and one Sales AE.
- RFP rubric validated against three historical RFPs (example attachments).
- Dashboard prototype in Console linking telemetry signals to a new Procurement Alerts widget.

Success metrics:
- Time-to-first-draft RFP artifact reduced from 5 business days to 48 hours for priority accounts.
- Increase in RFP conversions where we surface the brief during negotiation by +7% in next quarter.

Notes on trade-offs:
- We will prioritize clarity and speed over exhaustive vendor coverage; recommend maintaining a "deep-dive" annex for high-priority verticals (finserv, healthcare) outside this ticket.
- For latency/SLA evidence we will use 90th/95th pct metrics (rather than p99) to balance data availability and noise from rare infra events.
